# Switch
Applies a setting the moment it is toggled.

**When to use** — preferences and settings that take effect immediately, with no save step.
**When not to** — form values submitted later (Checkbox), or a choice between two named options (Tabs / segmented).

<!-- BEGIN:generated-structure -->

## Sizes
`sm` · `md`
Figma: `sm` · `md` · `lg` — differs from code (see `state/discrepancies.json`).

<!-- END:generated-structure -->

## Do
- Use `label` and `description` props rather than composing your own row.
- Make the change real — if the toggle needs a save button, it should be a Checkbox.
- Keep labels affirmative ("Push notifications", not "Disable push").

## Don't
- Don't put a Switch inside a form that has a Submit button for the same value.
- Don't use one for destructive or irreversible actions.

```tsx
<Switch label="Push notifications" description="Alerts on this device" checked={on} onCheckedChange={setOn} />
```
